The original CN and KR publications remain the authoritative sources for their own disclosures. The machine translations are non-authoritative reading aids; nothing in this memo represents them as certified or official. Open acquisition, equivalence, and materiality decisions are not a basis to delay transmission of the identified information for counsel's disclosure review. This memo does not assert that the USPTO will accept any translation; IDS compliance is determined under 37 CFR 1.97, 1.98, and 1.33 as a whole.
